title: SvgFeFlood
responsibility: Renders the native feFlood element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeFlood.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte snippet that supplies child content for the feFlood element, which matters only when the caller needs content inside it. The template renders it with {@render children()} only when it is provided, so an omitted value adds no child content, and because the template calls it as a function the value must be a snippet rather than a string.

outputs.name: SvgFeFlood
outputs.description: The native feFlood element itself, created in the SVG namespace with every forwarded attribute applied and the optional children rendered inside it. It matters when a caller needs the bare feFlood element with no wrapper added, and its limits come from the forwarded attributes and children, since this file does not validate either one.
